title.narrative: CLACSO Knowledge for a Sustainable World 2013-2018
CLACSO Kunskap för en hållbar värld 2013-2018

description.narrative: Program support to the Latin American Council for Social Sciences (CLACSO). The Council works with competitive research grants, regional thematic working groups, postgraduate courses, relations to the public sector and the civil society, publication and dissemination of research results etc.

Programstöd till det Latinamerikanska forskningsrådet för samhällsvetenskaper (CLACSO). Rådet arbetar med konkurrensutsatta forskningsstöd, regionala tematiska forskargrupper, forskarutbildningskurser, relationer till offentliga sektorn och civila samhället, publicering och spridning av forskningsresultat etc.

To promote research and postgraduate teaching, strengthening cooperation among researches and institutions in the field of Social Sciences.
Increase the use of Social Sciences quality research by policy makers, civil society and social organizations in order to contribute finding solutions to important problems in the region and thus supporting the construction of a democratic society, equitable and socially sustainable.
To disseminate academic production of Latin American and Caribbean researchers in support of public policy and governmental management, in order to contribute to democratic consolidation, promotion of human rights, sustainable development and culture of peace.

During the agreement period CLACSO was consolidated as a major network of social sciences and humanities in the world, globalizing its presence and impacts of research findings produced by the network. Membership increased considerably to about 600 institutional members at the end of the agreement period and CLACSO succeeded in diversification of funding, decreasing dependence on Sida funding to about 30%.
The major change produced during the time of the agreement was that CLACSO not only expanded quantitatively, but also expanded beyond the academic ambits, reaching public life spheres and influencing public opinion in several dozens of countries on a wide variety of social issues and problems. As an example, CLACSO contributed in generating awareness about the need for tax reforms and denunciation campaigns against wealth concentration and the elites state capture.
CLACSO increased the particpation of young researchers from priority countries (scientifically lagging countries), as well as female researchers, in the regional thematic working groups and the open calls for grants. CLACSO also promoted the inclusion of policy makers and civil society activists in the regional working groups and experimented with open calls for joint applications by researchers and practitioners in order to enhance societal impact.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
